_comment: Apple-hosted Background Assets packs (docs/NATIVE_PLAN.md §2). Built by pipeline/build_packs.py into data/packs/<id>.aar, uploaded LOCALLY by pipeline/upload_packs.sh (never from CI). Only OUR files go in packs (PMTiles, the plant-ID model) (Apple-hosted = our hosting, docs/LICENSING.md) — never F2F chapters, Understorey Network photos or tree data sheets. Files keep their data/ names at the pack root: all packs share ONE namespace on the device, so a name must be unique across packs. The app mirrors this table by hand in ios/IzzyMap/Sources/Data/Packs.swift (Pack, Archive.pack). Asset-pack IDs can never be reused once archived in App Store Connect — don't rename casually. policy: essential = blocks first launch until downloaded (counts towards the App Store 'Up to' size); prefetch = starts with the install, may finish after launch; onDemand = only when the app asks (one tap).

packs._comment: milestone 6 plant ID (pipeline/plantid/README.md 'Shipping artefacts' + 'Single model (v2)'): staged by build_packs.py from pipeline/cache/plantid/ship — the 8-bit encoder compiled to .mlmodelc (xcrun coremlcompiler), the single Australia-wide model (v2-*: build_ship.py v2), the Tasmanian photo bank it uses inside the Tasmania box (bank-int8.bin), pipeline.json (recipe, parameters, provenance, `model` identity) and the training-photo credits, all sha256-checked against pipeline.json. Our own files (trained on iNaturalist, ALA and Wikimedia Commons photos, credited in the app). A trailing '/' = a directory.

plant-ID reference photos, one per species (pipeline/plantid/build_refphotos_v2.py → cache/plantid/refphotos/pack-v2/refphotos/: the photos + index.json with file, licence, attribution, caption for herbarium/hand-held fallbacks; staged by build_packs.py into <out>/stage-refphotos/). index.json is listed as well as the folder: the app's installed check needs a file it can resolve. Optional for the app (RefPhotoFiles): without it Identify shows the Understorey Network photos or a name plate, and it never holds up the core-pack state. Photos © their creators, shown with their attribution line. A trailing '/' = a directory.
